items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: But anyhow Clowns Todd was on piano, Chiff and me was on trumpets, and this Ben man... Paul Ben.

ctx.x: Either him or Ricard, I can't remember which. They were both in there and I can never remember which is which. So let's see, you were in the army and who were some of the other New Orleans guys in the army with you?

Well, just Oscar Shields. There was about the three of us, oh no, what is I'm talking about? Clowns Todd, Chiff, there's a triumphant player named Ben. Ben, Ben something, he from off the river to a real Creole fellow. Ben, he named Ben, I can't think of his first name.
They call him Ben or something like that?
